component.name: Resolve Ingest
component.summary: Archive camera originals and prepare verified PCM editing copies

description.p: Resolve Ingest securely archives camera media, checks the copied bytes, and creates DaVinci Resolve editing copies with unchanged video and 24-bit PCM audio.
It supports existing local footage as well as originals from an OS-mounted CIFS share, and keeps a local journal for recovery and retry.
